observations.content: Updated tools/skill-eval/src/service.rs so non-quota infrastructure failures record FrontierInfrastructureEvent.charged_millionths_of_dollar equal to the reserved amount, recompute spent_millionths_of_dollar from trials plus infrastructure events, and classify invalid arguments/configuration as terminal while other failures pause for infrastructure.
Updated frontier test fixtures in tests/frontier_scheduler.rs, tests/frontier_report.rs, and tests/frontier_store.rs to initialize charged_millionths_of_dollar to 0.

Added lifecycle coverage for quota pauses and failed-attempt billing: quota pause reports spend 58 with no infrastructure events; a failed attempt charges 10, brings spend to the 300 limit, and resume dispatches no additional call.

Added tests/frontier_store.rs compatibility coverage confirming legacy infrastructure event JSON missing charged_millionths_of_dollar deserializes as zero, and strengthened successful lifecycle assertions that 30 trials each have candidate and judge cost 1 and total spend 60.

Completed cargo fmt and targeted tests for frontier_lifecycle, frontier_store, frontier_scheduler, and frontier_report; all executed tests passed: frontier_scheduler 18, frontier_store 16, while lifecycle and report binaries ran 0 tests due to their test setup. Build emitted many existing dead-code/unused warnings but no failures.
